client_regressions.analyze: Owned production and test files clean. Final VM plus new regression re-analysis clean.

confirmed_behaviors: Whole-document CAS uses exact original timestamp string, expected actor, immutable request UUID.
Lost responses retry identical payload/key before preparing a newer save.
Definitive conflict or permission rejection clears only the rejected pending request, resuming role/revision polling.
New edits during save remain dirty; upload completion preserves newer transforms and never resurrects a deleted layer.
Late responses/checkpoints cannot paint another album or account.
Conflict and offline checks keep local edits; explicit discard/reload is required to replace them.
Permission revocation preserves local pages in readonly UI with safe exit at 320 and 390 widths.
Home account replacement removes previous private list; late refresh/rollback cannot restore it.
Print correction checks fresh role and exact reviewed raw revision without advisory lock writes.
Existing cover editing saves all inner pages instead of replacing the book with legacy cover-only JSON.
collaboration_model: Concurrent local editing with server compare-and-swap. Foreground 15-second advisory checks; no automatic live merge or CRDT.
limits: No physical-device installation or QA: user phone unavailable, no USB request or emulator download.
An unknown initial album INSERT response still cannot be recovered by request ID; once the returned album ID is known, upload retries retain that ID.
Files belonging to an ambiguous submitted save are retained instead of speculatively deleted; only known-unsubmitted files are safely cleaned.
